bias.zh: 看空 · 小幅反弹，受制于 $142 下方

read.en: SpaceX rose 1.2% on Nov 2 to $136.37, trading between $135.72 and $142.05, with no 100-day yet (99 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($141.8), 10-day ($145.5) and 30-day ($151.9) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14, below zero, histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($161.44), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月2日上涨 1.2%，收于 $136.37，盘中区间 $135.72–142.05；上市仅 99 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$141.8）、10 日（$145.5）和 30 日均线（$151.9）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$161.44），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The bounce reached $142.05, above the $140.7 resistance (Oct 15 low), but closed back under it; the $134–134.5 support held. Resistance is $140.7–142.1 (Oct 15 low, 5-day, Nov 2 high), then $145.5 (10-day) and $151.9 (30-day). Support is $134–134.5 (Oct 30 and Aug 12 lows), then $130.2–130.4 (Aug 10 and 20 lows) and $120.4–122.1. A close above $142.1 would target $145.5; below $134, $130.
